snippet.title: Next Week at Freddy's — RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Survey the building, keep the facilities running, keep intruders out.
Think you can manage?
DOWNLOAD HERE: https://gamejolt.com/games/nwaf/683149

This trailer was storyboarded and produced by
MisterMacabre (https://x.com/Macabrecrypt)
and wreck9999 (https://x.com/wreck_9999 ).

Welcome to “Next Week at Freddy's”, a realism-based, fan-made reimagining of “Five Nights at Freddy's”. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, the game features enhanced graphics and spatial audio to immerse you in its atmosphere.
　Building off the game which inspired it, “Next Week at Freddy's” presents an expansive redesigned map, accompanied by smarter animatronic AI that provides them with numerous ways to reach and kill you. Animatronics will no longer roam aimlessly, Freddy, Bonnie, Chica and Foxy each have a unique way to make your night more stressful.
　As the player, you hold the power to maneuver the situation with your control panel - conveniently positioned directly behind you. Interact with the map strategically while using your computer to monitor cameras and gain valuable insights into the facility's workings and where the mascots are headed. Prepare yourself for a heart-pounding encounter at your next week at Freddy's!
